mapper.select: SELECT _NEXTINDEX('BOOKSET_SCHEME_SEQ') as booksetSchemeId, T.SCHEME_ID schemeId FROM BOK_VAL_SCHEME T WHERE T.ISDEFAULT = #{isdefault} limit 1

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, A.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType, A.P_FINPROD_ID AS pFinprodId, A.PROFIT_TYPE profitType, A.VDATE vdate, A.MDATE mdate, B.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId ,'F16' AS fLayeringType /**母金融产品类型**/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' UNION ALL SELECT concat_ws('', B.FINPROD_ID, date_format(B.VDATE,'%Y%m%d')) FINPROD_ID, B.FINPROD_TYPE, B.FINPROD_ID, B.PROFIT_TYPE profitType, B.VDATE vdate, B.MDATE mdate, C.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId ,'F16' AS fLayeringType /**母金融产品类型**/ FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT B LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT A ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_TYPE='F16' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C ON A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE='F22' AND B.BRANCH IS NOT NULL AND B.BRANCH != 0 UNION ALL SELECT E.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID, E.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE, NULL AS pFinprodId, F.ACCT_MODE AS profitType, F.START_DATE, F.END_DATE, NULL AS portfolioId ,NULL AS fLayeringType /**母金融产品类型**/ FROM BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO E LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET F ON E.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = F.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AND E.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = F.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE WHERE E.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE ='F18'
